title: Organic reaction-family compositional law
statement: An organic reaction family is the equivalence class of complete balanced reactant-product maps sharing one minimal bond-change pattern and role correspondence without assuming a common mechanism.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete carrier preservation, exact equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite generated set of balanced organic reactant-product atom maps with complete bond changes, functional roles, conditions and separate mechanism records.

choices.name: multiple-generated-reactions
choices.reason: The declared support has more than one member.

choices.name: reaction-names-only
choices.reason: Names do not establish common structure.

choices.name: complete-reactant-product-maps
choices.reason: Every atom and bond transition is retained.

choices.name: shared-bond-change-pattern
choices.reason: The same minimal transition trace recurs.

choices.name: reactant-product-role-correspondence
choices.reason: Input and output positions remain held.

choices.name: mechanism-assumed-from-pattern
choices.reason: Equal net changes need not share a mechanism.

choices.name: member-and-pattern-trace
choices.reason: Every map and equivalence decision is retained.

choices.name: free-reaction-taxonomy
choices.reason: An imported list can force membership.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Minimal recurring transition structure supplies the family.

induction_base: Two balanced reactions with one equal minimal bond-change trace supply the first family.
induction_step: Appending a matching reaction preserves the common trace; a nonmatching trace opens a distinct class.
exclusions: no stereochemical dictionary, organic reaction taxonomy, polymer table, biomolecular database, measured target or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no atom, bond, orientation, repeat unit, chain or observation distinction may be created, copied or silently erased
absence is an Empty structural form rather than numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite generated set of balanced organic reactant-product atom maps with complete bond changes, functional roles, conditions and separate mechanism records.
operational_witnesses: net pattern does not assert mechanism

target_rows.source_locator: authority source set anchored at R05164

falsification_condition: The claim fails if authority evidence lacks shared reaction pattern, reactant/product roles, separation from mechanism or condition boundary, or if a tampered row is accepted.
